title: 90% of US working hours are spent on tasks not covered well by AI benchmarks
summary: Mercor 的研究指出，美国工作时间的 90% 用于 AI 基准测试未充分覆盖的任务，说明现有 AI 评测与实际工作需求存在显著差距。
highlights: 90% of US working hours are spent on tasks not covered well by AI benchmarks
Highlights the gap between AI benchmark coverage and real-world work tasks
Based on Mercor Labor Index research
